title: fix(app-shell): a report's or dataset's Label with no machine name leaves the Name empty (objectui#12789)
body:
Fixes #12789
Clause-②: no (designer only; no export, prop or type changes)

## What changes

In create mode, the report and dataset designers derive the **Name** from the **Label** until the author types a Name. They derived it with `toFieldName`, which returns the placeholder `field` when nothing is left. So a Label in a non-Latin script (`收入`), or a cleared Label, named the report or dataset `field` without telling the author. The dataset then saved as `field` (reading below), and a second such item would collide with it.

Both Label handlers now derive with `toFieldNameOrEmpty`, a new function beside `toFieldName` in `previews/object-fields-io.ts`. It applies the same strict rule, but returns `''` where `toFieldName` returns `field`. The Name stays empty, as it does in the object designer (whose `slugify` returns `''`), and the save path asks the author for a name. `nameFollowsLabel` compares the stored Name with the same function. So:

- a Name left empty by a non-Latin Label still follows a Latin Label typed later;
- a Name the author typed is never taken for the placeholder. On `main`, a Name typed as `field` next to a non-Latin Label was overwritten by the next Label edit.

A Label that yields a machine name derives exactly what it derived before: the strict form, no trailing `_`, the `f_` prefix for a leading digit, and `field` from the Label `Field`.

`toFieldName` keeps its `field` fallback. Its body is now `toFieldNameOrEmpty(raw) || 'field'`, which returns the same result for every input. Its existing pin in `object-fields-io.test.ts` is unchanged and green: `toFieldName('')` and `toFieldName('报修工单')` both return `field`. Its other callers:

- `CreateItemDialog` (studio-design) **relies on** the fallback: it treats a `finalName` equal to `field` as "the input yielded no identifier" and refuses to submit.
- `genGroupKey` never reaches the fallback: it calls `toFieldName` only when the label has an ASCII letter or digit, and uses `group` otherwise.
- `ObjectFormCanvas` re-exports it, and nothing in the repository imports that re-export.

The new function lives in a module that the package's `exports` (`.` only) and its `src/index.ts` barrel do not name. So the package entry is unchanged, as the `Clause-②` line says.

Files: `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx` (the import, the `nameFollowsLabel` comparison, the Label handler's derivation, and comments), `previews/object-fields-io.ts` (the new function, with `toFieldName` delegating to it), one new test beside each inspector, a `toFieldNameOrEmpty` block in `object-fields-io.test.ts`, and `.changeset/12789-report-dataset-label-leaves-name-empty.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Browser readings (Chromium, real keystrokes)

Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port. A writable package was created with `POST /api/v1/packages` `{"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.vrf",…,"namespace":"qavrf"}}` → 201. Console: this branch's worktree on Vite, proxied to that backend. "Before" was read at `8df2608` (unchanged `main`, before any edit). "After" was read at `e4b532b`, on the same dev server after the edit. Pages: `/apps/crm_app/metadata/{report,dataset,object}/new?package=com.qa.vrf`.

The sequence on a fresh form: type the Label `收入`, then Tab. Then clear the Label. Then type `Revenue Board ` and `Q` into the cleared Label.

| designer | Name after Label `收入`, before → after | Name after the Label is cleared, before → after | Latin Label typed onto the cleared one (mid / final), before and after |
|---|---|---|---|
| report | `field` → empty | `field` → empty | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |
| dataset | `field` → empty | `field` → empty | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |
| object (control) | empty → empty | empty → empty | `revenue_board` / `revenue_board_q` (unchanged) |

On a second fresh form, the Label was typed as `Revenue`, then replaced with `收入`, then with `Revenue Board`. The Name read `revenue` → `field` → `revenue_board` before, and `revenue` → empty → `revenue_board` after, in both designers. The object designer read `revenue` → empty → `revenue_board` both times.

### What Save says (Label `收入`, the Name left as derived, Save pressed)

| designer | before (`8df2608`): Name `field` | after (`e4b532b`): Name empty |
|---|---|---|
| report | `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/field?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vrf` → 422. The name passed; the request was refused only because no dataset was bound ("a report needs `dataset` + `values` (measure names).") | no request. Banners: "A name is required." and "This metadata does not match the spec — 2 validation error(s).", with Name "Identifier must be at least 2 characters" and "Identifier must be lowercase snake_case, starting with a letter, and may contain only letters, numbers, and underscores" |
| dataset | `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/field?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vrf` → 200, "Saved dataset 'field' (env-wide, package=com.qa.vrf, state=draft)" | no request. Banner: "A name is required." |
| object (control) | no request. "A name is required." and the spec banner (1 error: Name must match `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`) | the same |

So an empty Name asks the author for one: the host's save path refuses an empty identity ("A name is required.") before any request is sent, and the client spec check names the identifier rule.

## Tests

New, one beside each inspector. Each renders the inspector with a host double that merges every patch back into the draft, and types real keystrokes with user-event:

- `ReportDefaultInspector.labelLeavesNameEmpty-12789.test.tsx`
- `DatasetDefaultInspector.labelLeavesNameEmpty-12789.test.tsx`

Each file pins five things:

1. The Label `收入` leaves the Name empty, in the box and in the draft.
2. A cleared Label leaves the Name empty: `Revenue` derives `revenue`, and clearing the Label empties it.
3. A Name left empty by `收入` still follows a Latin Label typed later (`Revenue Board` derives `revenue_board`).
4. A Name the author typed as `field` while the Label is `收入` stays `field` after a later Latin Label.
5. Control: a Latin Label still derives the strict form. `2024 Revenue` derives `f_2024_revenue`, and the Label `Field` derives `field`.

`object-fields-io.test.ts` gains a `toFieldNameOrEmpty` block. It returns `''` where `toFieldName` returns `field` (empty, blank, `收入`, `报修工单`, punctuation only), and the same value as `toFieldName` on every input that yields a name.

Run at `e4b532b`, after the closure build, in repo-root form: `pnpm exec vitest run` over every file whose name starts with `ReportDefaultInspector`, `DatasetDefaultInspector` or `ObjectDefaultInspector`, every `object-fields-io` test, `ResourceEditPage.nameSurvivesLabel-12680.test.tsx`, and both `CreateItemDialog` tests (the caller that relies on the fallback) → `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 235 passed (235)`.

## Red on unchanged main, and the ablations

Each leg ran the two new inspector test files (10 tests); A5 also ran `object-fields-io.test.ts`. Every mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout: the anchor was hit once, the replacement landed, and the blob changed on disk. R0 replaced whole files instead, checked by blob hash against `8df2608`. Every restore was proven by a blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, and the tree was clean at the end (0 changed paths). The tests import the inspectors and `object-fields-io` through relative source paths, so no `dist/` build sits between a mutation and its run.

| leg | mutation (both inspectors unless noted) | result | what went red |
|---|---|---|---|
| R0: unchanged main | both inspectors replaced by their `8df2608` blobs (`toFieldNameOrEmpty` count 0) | 8 failed, 2 passed | pins 1, 2 and 4 in both files, and pin 3 at its first step (`field` where an empty Name is expected) |
| A1 (pins 1, 2) | the derivation gets the placeholder back: `toFieldNameOrEmpty(v) \|\| 'field'` | 6 failed, 4 passed | pins 1, 2 and 3 in both files |
| A2 (pin 4) | the `nameFollowsLabel` comparison gets the placeholder back: `(toFieldNameOrEmpty(…) \|\| 'field')` | 2 failed, 8 passed | pin 4 in both files: the next Label edit replaced the author's `field` with `revenue` |
| A3a (pin 5) | the derivation treats `field` as "no name": `toFieldNameOrEmpty(v) === 'field' ? '' : toFieldNameOrEmpty(v)` | 2 failed, 8 passed | pin 5 in both files: the Label `Field` left the Name empty |
| A5 (helper; `object-fields-io.ts`) | `toFieldNameOrEmpty` returns `'field'` instead of `''` | 9 failed, 41 passed | the helper's first pin, and pins 1–4 in both inspector files |

Two more legs stayed green, and each green has a cause:

- **A3**: the derivation swapped for `toFieldNameLoose`. Both rules `trim()` first, so they differ only on trailing punctuation, which none of these pins type. That difference is pinned by objectui#12746's pin 3 (`Revenue -- Board ` derives `revenue_board`). Its file is in the suite run above, and PR #12788 ablated it.
- **A4**: the `nameValue === ''` arm dropped from `nameFollowsLabel`. With the comparison now on `toFieldNameOrEmpty`, an empty Name next to a non-Latin Label equals the Label's derivation, so pin 3 holds through the comparison alone. The arm still matters for a Name the author clears next to a Latin Label, which these pins do not cover.

## Local gates (all at `e4b532b`)

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` → exit 0 (scope 29 of 47 workspace projects).
- the vitest run above → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) → exit 0. `--listFiles` on the test project lists both new test files and `object-fields-io.test.ts`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the six changed source and test files → exit 0, 0 errors. All 7 warnings fall on lines this diff does not touch (`react-refresh/only-export-components`, `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0: "6 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → exit 0, `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.

CI runs everything else.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not changed here:** `CreateItemDialog` (studio-design) still uses `toFieldName`'s `field` as a sentinel (`finalName !== 'field'`), so it also refuses an input whose real identifier is `field`, such as the Label `Field`. I read this from source and did not reproduce it in a browser. Nobody is carrying it. `toFieldNameOrEmpty` would replace the sentinel if anyone takes it up.
- **Found while measuring, reported to the seat, not filed from here:** with no base object picked, the dataset designer's Save sends `"object":"example_object"`, the spec create seed's placeholder object. Reading: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/probe_ds?mode=draft&package=com.qa.vrf` with body `{"name":"probe_ds","label":"Probe Ds","object":"example_object",…}` → 200, while the Base object box read "Select an object…". This change does not touch it.
